title: Steve Spagnuolo: Jaxon Smith-Njigba is "really elite"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Steve Spagnuolo: Jaxon Smith-Njigba is "really elite"
sources.description: With the Chiefs facing the Seahawks on Sunday night, Kansas City defensive coordinator Steve Spagnuolo has the unenviable task of scheming to slow down Jaxon Smith-Njigba.
